This template is to be used for linking to the corresponding concept art category for a piece of media.

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article (as outlined in the [[Wookieepedia:Layout_Guide/In-universe#Mediacat|Layout Guide]]), and fill in the required fields.

<code><nowiki>{{Conceptcat|imagecat=|artbook=}}</nowiki></code>

===Parameters===
*'''imagecat''': (required) Name of the category for the concept art of the article subject, minus its namespace prefix (<code><nowiki>Category:</nowiki></code>).
*'''artbook''': (required) Name of the media's art book.

===Example(s)===
<code><nowiki>{{Conceptcat|imagecat=Solo: A Star Wars Story concept art|artbook=The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Conceptcat|imagecat=Solo: A Star Wars Story concept art|artbook=The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story}}
{{Clear}}
